blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Customers say this setting spray keeps…
blocks_element.text: Customers say this setting spray keeps makeup in place all day, even through heat, sweat, and humidity. Many appreciate how it locks makeup without feeling sticky or heavy, with several noting it performs well during intense activities like workouts and water exposure. The formula creates a matte finish and doesn't feel suffocating on skin. Some mention the alcohol scent fades quickly. A few users note concerns about durability in extreme moisture or wish for better nozzle functionality. Overall, customers find it effective for long-lasting makeup wear.
